children: AMC expects approximately $150 million of free cash flow in 2026 after a $120 million settlement, including an $85 million cash payment and related charge.
Entered settlement resolving 2022 breach-of-contract claims; total consideration $120 million.
Settlement comprises $85 million cash by Sept 18, 2026 and $35 million paid by Jan 31, 2027 as an advance.
Company will take an ~ $85 million charge in Q3 2026 for dismissal of the actions with prejudice.
2026 free cash flow outlook cut from ~$220M to ~$150M, which includes the $85M cash payment net of tax; revenue and adjusted operating income outlook unchanged.
